$comment: Pinned HMAC port-token vector (b8 §3.26, §4.5; D8). token = v1.<b64url(payload)>.<b64url(HMAC-SHA256(base64decode(secretB64), 'v1.' + b64url(payload)))>, payload serialised compactly in the field order ws, port, sub, iat, exp, jti. Consumed by sandbox/supervisor/src/port_auth.rs (port_token_vector) and b9's port_session_matches_b8_vector.
